# 2D, text and UI

Sprites, tilemaps, 2D lights and cameras, world text, UI canvases and dialogue.

## `sprite` { #sprite }

A textured quad on the entity's XY plane (2D characters, props, backgrounds, pixel art, 2.5D billboards). Painter's order: sortingLayer, then order, then depth.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `texture` | string | Image (png/jpg) or atlas (*.atlas.json), project-relative |  |
| `frame` | string | Atlas frame name or frame index ("3"); empty = first frame / whole image |  |
| `columns` | integer | Grid sheet columns (frames left-&gt;right, top-&gt;bottom) |  |
| `rows` | integer | Grid sheet rows |  |
| `region` | number[] | Explicit pixel rect [x, y, w, h] in the image (overrides frame) |  |
| `pivot` | number[2] | Origin within the frame: [0.5, 0.5] center, [0.5, 0] feet, [0, 0] bottom-left |  |
| `size` | number[2] | World size [w, h]; 0 = pixels / pixelsPerUnit (one 0 keeps the aspect) |  |
| `pixelsPerUnit` | number | Texture pixels per world unit (pixel art: 16 or 32) | 0.01 .. 100000 |
| `color` | color | Tint and opacity — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `flipX` | boolean | Mirror horizontally (face left) |  |
| `flipY` | boolean | Mirror vertically |  |
| `sortingLayer` | string | Draw layer (back to front) | `background` `midground` `default` `foreground` `overlay` |
| `order` | integer | Order within the layer (higher = in front) |  |
| `filter` | string | Texture sampling: linear (painted art) or nearest (pixel art) | `linear` `nearest` |
| `normalMap` | string | Normal map for 2D lighting (optional) |  |
| `emissive` | color | Glow color, alpha = strength (blooms) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `billboard` | string | Face the camera: none, y (upright, turns around Y) or full | `none` `y` `full` |
| `lit` | boolean | Lit by 2D lights when the scene has any (else full bright) |  |
| `castShadows` | boolean | Blocks shadow-casting 2D lights |  |
| `alphaCutoff` | number | Hard cutout below this alpha (0 = soft edges) | 0 .. 1 |
| `visible` | boolean | Whether the sprite is drawn |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"sprite": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.sprite.texture          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `sprite_anim` { #sprite_anim }

Flipbook animation for the entity's sprite. clips: {"run": {"frames": "4-11", "fps": 12, "loop": true, "events": {"3": "footstep"}}}. frames: index ranges ("0-3,6"), lists ([0, 1, 2] or ["run_0", ...]) or an atlas name pattern ("run_*"); a clip may switch sheets with "texture", "columns", "rows". Frame events reach the entity's behaviors as `on anim "footstep"`; non-looping clips send `on anim "finished"`.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clips` | object | Clip name -&gt; {frames, fps, loop, events, texture?, columns?, rows?} |  |
| `clip` | string | Clip playing now (Wander: play_anim(self, "run")) |  |
| `playing` | boolean | Advance frames |  |
| `speed` | number | Playback speed multiplier | 0 .. 100 |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"sprite_anim": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.sprite_anim.clips          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `tilemap` { #tilemap }

A grid of tiles in layers. Cell (0, 0) is the top-left at the entity position; cells go right (+x) and down (-y) in world space. Tile ids: 0 = empty, n = the n-th tile of the tileset (1-based, left->right, top->bottom). Edit with tilemap_paint / tilemap_from_ascii; layer data is compact text ("rle:..." or "b64z:...").

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tileset` | string | Tileset image (grid of tiles) or *.tileset.json |  |
| `tileSize` | integer | Tile size in tileset pixels |  |
| `cellSize` | number | World units per cell | 0.001 .. 1000 |
| `width` | integer | Columns |  |
| `height` | integer | Rows |  |
| `layers` | object[] | [{name, data, solid (true \| "tiles"), visible, z, tint, sortingLayer, order}] bottom to top |  |
| `solidTiles` | array | Tile ids that collide in layers with solid: "tiles" ([3, "10-20"]) |  |
| `autotile` | object | Terrains for auto-tiling: {"wall": {"mode": "blob47" \| "wang16", "first": 33}} or "tiles": [ids] |  |
| `color` | color | Tint — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `sortingLayer` | string | Draw layer of all tile layers (unless a layer overrides it) | `background` `midground` `default` `foreground` `overlay` |
| `order` | integer | Order within the sorting layer (each tile layer adds its index) |  |
| `filter` | string | Texture sampling | `nearest` `linear` |
| `lit` | boolean | Lit by 2D lights |  |
| `castShadows` | boolean | Solid tiles block shadow-casting 2D lights |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"tilemap": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.tilemap.tileset          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `light2d` { #light2d }

A 2D light: point, spot (cone along the entity's local +Y) or global (ambient for the whole 2D scene). With any 2D light in the scene, lit sprites are dark except where light falls; normal maps add relief.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | point \| spot \| global (ambient) | `point` `spot` `global` |
| `color` | color | Light color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `intensity` | number | Brightness (HDR: &gt; 1 blooms) | 0 .. 1000 |
| `radius` | number | Reach in world units | 0.01 .. 100000 |
| `falloff` | number | Attenuation exponent: 1 linear, 2 soft, 4 tight | 0.1 .. 16 |
| `innerAngle` | number | Spot: full-intensity half-angle (degrees) | 0 .. 180 |
| `outerAngle` | number | Spot: cutoff half-angle (degrees) | 0 .. 180 |
| `height` | number | Height above the sprite plane (normal-map relief) | 0 .. 100 |
| `shadows` | boolean | Cast shadows from castShadows sprites and solid tiles |  |
| `shadowSoftness` | number | Penumbra softness | 0 .. 1 |
| `halo` | number | Visible glow in the air around the light | 0 .. 10 |
| `flicker` | number | Candle/torch flicker amount | 0 .. 1 |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"light2d": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.light2d.kind          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `parallax` { #parallax }

Parallax scrolling for this entity and its children (2D, orthographic cameras): they move at `factor` of the camera's motion. 0 = fixed to the camera (sky), 0.1-0.6 = far layers, 1 = normal, > 1 = near foreground.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `factor` | number[2] | Motion relative to the camera per axis |  |
| `origin` | number[2] | Camera position at which the layer is at its authored position |  |
| `repeatX` | boolean | Repeat sprites horizontally to fill the view (endless backgrounds) |  |
| `repeatY` | boolean | Repeat sprites vertically |  |
| `spacing` | number | Repeat period in world units (0 = sprite size) | 0 .. 1000000 |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"parallax": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.parallax.factor          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `camera2d` { #camera2d }

2D camera behavior (put it on the camera entity): orthographic, pixel-perfect integer scaling, texel snapping, smooth target following with a dead zone, and level bounds.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pixelsPerUnit` | number | Art texels per world unit (match the sprites) | 0.01 .. 100000 |
| `referenceHeight` | integer | Game pixels tall (e.g. 180 or 270): integer upscaling for crisp pixel art; 0 = camera.orthoSize |  |
| `pixelSnap` | boolean | Snap the view to the texel grid (no shimmering) |  |
| `zoom` | number | Zoom factor (&gt; 1 = closer) | 0.01 .. 100 |
| `follow` | string | Entity to follow (name) |  |
| `smoothing` | number | Follow lag in seconds (0 = rigid) | 0 .. 10 |
| `deadZone` | number[2] | Half-size of the box the target moves in without moving the camera |  |
| `offset` | number[2] | Framing offset from the target |  |
| `bounds` | number[] | [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] the view stays inside (all 0 = unbounded) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"camera2d": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.camera2d.pixelsPerUnit          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `text` { #text }

Text in the world (signs, labels, damage numbers, speech bubbles). SDF-rendered: crisp at any zoom. Supports rich text: <b> <i> <u> <s> <color=#f80> <size=150%> <font=serif> <br>.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | The text (rich text tags allowed) |  |
| `font` | string | Inter (default), EB Garamond (serif), JetBrains Mono (mono), or a .ttf path |  |
| `size` | number | Em size in world units | 0.001 .. 10000 |
| `color` | color | Text color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `align` | string | Horizontal alignment around the entity | `left` `center` `right` `justify` |
| `valign` | string | Vertical alignment around the entity | `top` `middle` `bottom` |
| `maxWidth` | number | Wrap width in world units (0 = no wrap) | 0 .. 1000000 |
| `lineSpacing` | number | Line height multiplier | 0.1 .. 10 |
| `outline` | number | Outline width in em | 0 .. 0.15 |
| `outlineColor` | color | Outline color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `shadowColor` | color | Drop shadow color (alpha 0 = none) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `shadowOffset` | number[2] | Drop shadow offset in world units |  |
| `emissive` | number | Glow strength (neon signs bloom) | 0 .. 100 |
| `billboard` | string | Face the camera | `none` `y` `full` |
| `sortingLayer` | string | Draw layer | `background` `midground` `default` `foreground` `overlay` |
| `order` | integer | Order within the layer |  |
| `visible` | boolean | Whether the text is drawn |  |

## `ui_canvas` { #ui_canvas }

Root of a user interface. Children with a `ui` component are laid out in canvas pixels (origin top-left, y down). screen = overlay scaled from referenceResolution; world = a panel in the scene. Build whole UIs with ui_create; restyle with ui_style.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | screen overlay or world-space panel | `screen` `world` |
| `referenceResolution` | number[2] | Design resolution [w, h] in pixels |  |
| `scaleMode` | string | scale_with_screen (resolution independent) or constant (1 px = 1 px) | `scale_with_screen` `constant` |
| `match` | number | Scaling: 0 = match width, 1 = match height | 0 .. 1 |
| `sortOrder` | integer | Canvases draw in ascending order |  |
| `theme` | string | Built-in look | `dark` `light` `parchment` `glass` `pixel` |
| `styleSheet` | string | Style sheet (*.uistyle.json) layered over the theme |  |
| `worldScale` | number | World mode: world units per canvas pixel | 1e-05 .. 100 |
| `interactable` | boolean | Receives mouse/keyboard input |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"ui_canvas": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.ui_canvas.mode          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `ui` { #ui }

A UI element under a ui_canvas. Rect: anchor preset + position (offset, y down) + size, or stretch with margin. A layout (row/column/grid) arranges children with gap/padding/align/justify; fit sizes to content. Look comes from the theme/style sheet by widget kind and `style` classes, plus styleOverrides. Activating a button/toggle/slider sends Wander `on ui "<name>"` (and `on click` to the element).

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `widget` | string | What it is | `panel` `image` `text` `button` `toggle` `slider` `progress` `scroll` `input` `spacer` |
| `anchor` | string | Where it attaches in its parent: corners/edges/center, fill, or *_stretch bands; custom uses anchorMin/anchorMax/pivot | `top_left` `top` `top_right` `left` `center` `right` `bottom_left` `bottom` `bottom_right` `fill` `top_stretch` `middle_stretch` `bottom_stretch` `left_stretch` `center_stretch` `right_stretch` `custom` |
| `anchorMin` | number[2] | custom anchor: parent fraction [x, y] (0,0 = top-left) |  |
| `anchorMax` | number[2] | custom anchor: parent fraction [x, y]; differs from anchorMin = stretch |  |
| `pivot` | number[2] | custom anchor: the element's own reference point [x, y] (0,0 = top-left) |  |
| `position` | number[2] | Offset from the anchor in pixels [x, y] (y down) |  |
| `size` | number[2] | Size in pixels [w, h] (ignored on stretched axes) |  |
| `margin` | number[] | Insets on stretched axes [top, right, bottom, left] |  |
| `layout` | string | Arrange children | `none` `row` `column` `grid` |
| `gap` | number | Space between children (pixels) | 0 .. 100000 |
| `padding` | number[] | Inner padding [top, right, bottom, left] (CSS shorthand ok: 12 or [8, 16]) |  |
| `align` | string | Children on the cross axis | `start` `center` `end` `stretch` |
| `justify` | string | Children on the main axis | `start` `center` `end` `space_between` |
| `columns` | integer | Grid columns |  |
| `fit` | string | Size to content (children or text) | `none` `width` `height` `both` |
| `flex` | number | Share of leftover space in a row/column (0 = fixed size) | 0 .. 1000 |
| `ignoreLayout` | boolean | Placed by its own anchor even inside a layout |  |
| `text` | string | Label or content (rich text) |  |
| `image` | string | Image path or atlas frame ("ui.atlas.json#heart") |  |
| `value` | number | Slider/progress value; toggle: 0 or 1 |  |
| `minValue` | number | Slider/progress minimum |  |
| `maxValue` | number | Slider/progress maximum |  |
| `placeholder` | string | Input: hint shown when empty |  |
| `style` | string | Style classes, space separated ("primary large") |  |
| `styleOverrides` | object | Inline style properties ({"background": "#223", "radius": 12}) |  |
| `event` | string | Extra event sent when activated (in addition to ui:&lt;name&gt;) |  |
| `interactable` | boolean | Receives input (disabled look when false) |  |
| `visible` | boolean | Shown (hidden elements and their children take no space) |  |
| `scroll` | number | Scroll views: content offset in pixels |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"ui": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.ui.widget          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `dialogue` { #dialogue }

Runs a .dialogue script (Yarn-style: nodes, `Speaker: line #tags`, `-> choices`, <<set>>, <<if>>, <<jump>>, custom <<commands>> sent to Wander as `on dialogue "name"`) with a built-in, restylable dialogue box. Start it with Wander start_dialogue("Node"); lint with dialogue_check; simulate with dialogue_preview.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `script` | string | Dialogue file (*.dialogue), project-relative |  |
| `source` | string | Inline script (used when script is empty) |  |
| `startNode` | string | Node to start at |  |
| `autoStart` | boolean | Start when play begins |  |
| `ui` | string | default = built-in dialogue box; none = drive your own UI | `default` `none` |
| `typewriter` | number | Characters per second (0 = instant) | 0 .. 10000 |
| `portraits` | string | Folder for #portrait:&lt;name&gt; tags (&lt;name&gt;.png) |  |
| `running` | boolean | State: a conversation is in progress |  |
| `node` | string | State: current node |  |
| `speaker` | string | State: speaker of the current line |  |
| `line` | string | State: current line text |  |
| `choices` | string[] | State: current choices (array of strings) |  |
| `tags` | object | State: tags of the current line ({"mood": "angry"}) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"dialogue": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.dialogue.script          -- read or write any field
    ```
